rules.name: EARTH'S VITALITY
rules.text: Defend 3 in every land where you have [Sacred Site] .
rules.turn: spirit:special S earths-vitality, sacred-site S L / defend-total L 3
rules.evidence: without the rule: damage-land l2 5; with Earth's Sacred Site in l2: damage-land l2 2 (5 - Defend 3)
rules.notes: A static ability is a standing acc contribution to the base defend-total @sum, recomputed every moment, so it switches off automatically when the Sacred Site is lost (e.g. Blight destroys a Presence). Simplest rule in the group: one line.
